units: Lev. XX, 16) carnal connection with beasts, buggery.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:1">Ab. Zar. II, 1</cite> <he>מפני … הר׳</he> because they (the gentiles) are suspected of using beasts for buggery.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 40b">B. Kam. 40ᵇ</cite>, sq.; a. e.
<cite ref="Taanit 6b:1">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>עד … ר׳ שנייה</he> until the second rainfall comes down.

<cite ref="Taanit 6b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי לשון ר׳ דבר שרובע וכ׳</he> what is the radical meaning of <cite ref="T00101"><he>רביעה</he></cite>? Something which fructifies the ground, as R. J. says, ‘the rain is the husband &c.’ <cite ref="Taanit 6b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ ראשונה כדי וכ׳</he> the first rainfall (is satisfactory, and you need no fast-day), when there is enough to enter the ground to the depth of one handbreadth; <he>ר׳ שנייה כדי לגוף וכ׳</he> the second rainfall (is satisfactory), when the soil is fit to be used for sealing the mouth of a cask. Ib. 6ᵃ; Tosef. ib. I, 3. Ib. 4 <he>רביע</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.).
Gen. R. s. 13 כדי ר׳ enough rain to be called r’biʿah (fructification); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 1:9">Tosef. B. Kam. I, 9</cite> <he>ועל ר׳</he> ed. Zuck., v. <cite ref="T00110"><he>רְבִיצָה</he></cite>.]
